title: Ultra Hardcore Attributes
description: A mod that makes your game much harder than it needs to be by changing your attributes!
body:
Ultra Hardcore Attributes
Think Minecraft is too easy? This mod will make it brutal. Ultra Hardcore Attributes makes survival way tougher by changing your basic attributes. Every little thing becomes a challenge, and even the simplest tasks feel dangerous.

Main Changes
Half Health: You only get 5 hearts total. Every hit is a risk.

No Swimming: You sink in water. Rivers and oceans are deadly.

Fire Burns Longer: If you catch fire, it lasts 30 seconds. Lava is basically a death sentence.

Weak Attacks: Your fists only deal 0.2 damage. Fighting mobs is slow and painful.

No Jumping: The jump key makes you do a short dash instead (not really on purpose, but it works).

Tiny Jump Boost: With Jump Boost II, you can just barely hop onto a trapdoor. That’s it.

Short Reach: You can only hit or break things from 1.5 blocks away.

Slower Speed: You move a little slower than normal.
